meta.title: Aidan Lusk | Account, Brand & Project Management
meta.description: Portfolio of Aidan Lusk, an Advertising & Brand Management graduate looking for Account Manager, Account Supervisor, Project Manager, and Brand Manager roles.

hero.support: I turn consumer research into a clear brief, a clear brief into a campaign, and a campaign into something a client can approve.

work.title: Selected work
work.intro: Six projects, each taken from research and brief through to finished creative. They are spec and class work unless noted. Open one for the summary, gallery, and full deck.

approach.title: How I run the work
approach.intro: Account and brand management is mostly making sure the right people are solving the right problem at the right time. These are the habits I bring to it.

principles.title: Start with the business problem
principles.body: Every project here opens the same way: who the audience is, what they believe now, and what needs to change. The Bialetti campaign was never about a coffee maker. It was about a category that had made mornings feel rushed.

principles.title: Listen before recommending
principles.body: The AI companion study began with two long interviews and ended with twelve findings. The brand directions came from what people said, including the things we did not expect to hear.

principles.title: One idea, every channel
principles.body: A campaign holds together when the bus shelter, the Instagram carousel, and the microsite all say the same thing in their own way. I plan the whole system before the first layout.

principles.title: Keep everyone on the same page
principles.body: Timelines, feedback rounds, and decisions go in writing where the whole team can see them. A client should never be surprised by a date, a cost, or a change in direction.
